facts.summary: FDA refused to file BLA, wants efficacy evidence and CMC info · Filed (BLA) · pegzilarginase in Arginase 1 Deficiency · not yet approved

evidence.summary: announced that it received a Refusal to File letter (the “RTF letter”) from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (the “FDA”) regarding the Company’s Biologics License Application (“BLA”) for pegzilarginase
evidence.safety: There were no issues related to safety raised in the RTF letter.
evidence.program_discontinued: The Company intends to request a Type A meeting with the FDA to clarify and respond to the items identified in the RTF letter.
